name: @ai-ecoverse/slack
description: The slack, slack-ext, slack-support and intercom CLIs for jsh on a host. They drive a logged-in Slack tab in Chrome over an existing DevTools Protocol connection (SLICC_CDP_URL, default http://127.0.0.1:9222). `npm install -g` or `pnpm add -g` this folder to put them on PATH.
